## Privacy & Cookies

This website uses Google Analytics to collect aggregate, anonymized information about how the site is used (for example, which pages are visited and how often). This information is used solely to understand general site usage and to improve the content and organization of the materials.

### What data are collected

Page views and navigation patterns Approximate geographic region (e.g., country or state) Device and browser type Interactions such as scrolling or file downloads

Google Analytics does **not** intentionally collect personally identifying information such as names, email addresses, or exact IP addresses.

### Cookies and consent

Analytics cookies are only set **after you provide consent** using the cookie banner shown on your first visit. If you decline analytics cookies, no Google Analytics tracking is performed. You may change your preference at any time by clearing your browser cookies and revisiting the site.

**This site does not use advertising, remarketing, or personalized ads.** Any references to advertising or personalizeation options in the cookie-preference dialog reflect generic browser controls and are not used by this site.

**Third‑party services** Google Analytics is provided by Google LLC. Data collected by Google Analytics may be processed by Google under its own privacy policies. This site does not use analytics data for advertising, user profiling, or marketing.
